title: Bundled console data
responsibility: Reads console JSON and media lazily from modules compiled into a server bundle.

inputs.name: consoleBundle.modules
inputs.description: Maps of JSON and media module loaders. JSON modules default-export text; media modules default-export base64 and export a MIME type string. Loader paths end in the requested filename plus .ts.

outputs.name: consoleBundle
outputs.description: Data reader with async json and media methods. Missing loaders or wrong export types yield undefined; media is decoded into original bytes with its MIME type. No module loads until requested.
